caveats: Quality is MMLU exact multiple-choice letter accuracy under direct choice-token scoring, not free-form generation quality.
MMLU dev has five per-task examples for the static selector; that selector is high variance.
Latency is local MPS forward-pass time, excluding loading and tokenization; no energy meter or concurrent serving benchmark was available.
Three validation timing repetitions quantify within-hardware variation; test call times are one measurement per model/query.
Query bootstrap uncertainty is conditional on one fixed 160-query official test subset and does not represent model/dataset/hardware variation.
Test oracle uses the answer key retrospectively and is not deployable.
confidence_signal: normalized softmax mass for the model's selected A-D letter from first next-token logits; observable, uncalibrated

confidence_signal_diagnostics.definition: normalized next-token probability mass for the selected A-D letter; Brier compares this score with exact correctness; error AUC uses 1-confidence to rank errors

inference_configuration.method: one causal language model forward pass per query; score A-D next-token masses
inference_configuration.policy_latency_cost: per-query median of three repeated measured forward-pass times; cascade sums A and activated B serially
inference_configuration.prompt: same MMLU instruction prompt as prior pilot

latency_note: The per-query cost used by policy curves is the median of three repeated forward-pass timings for that query/model. Bootstrap resamples 160 queries stratified by task, not timing repetitions.
memory_note: Per-model FP16 parameter bytes are exact tensor storage. MPS driver allocations are cumulative as models are loaded in candidate order; the last value is the resident pool footprint, not a per-model increment.

partition_validation.check: SHA-256 of question plus choices across auxiliary_train/dev/validation/test and prior pilot test

provenance.original_test_outcomes: read-only; all prior result directories remain unchanged

locked_configuration.pair_selection: B is more accurate and slower than A on both train and validation; eligible pair ranked by highest train accuracy of B, then B latency, then A latency
locked_configuration.test_selection_rule: 40 official test items per subject; exclude prior pilot questions by content
